question: Who in Team IS1005 wanted radio waves instead of infra-red and why, what arguments were made against it, and which signal type did they choose?
answer: Speaker C (User Interface Designer) preferred radio waves because infra-red had to be aimed in a specific direction and was difficult to tune; Speaker A also acknowledged the obstacle/aiming limitation. Against radio waves, Speaker B cited high price and said infra-red’s range was adequate, while Speaker D argued the extra expense was not worthwhile because customers expected infra-red and money should go toward usability. The team chose infra-red, citing its company-developed communication chip and low cost.
